Comfy Sidebar_Show Pending Count Only.name: If disabled, each queued job will have a separate individual card

Comfy Sidebar_Show Working Node Name.name: Shows the name of the node which is currently in the process

Comfy Sidebar_Auto Clear Interrupted.name: Auto-clear cancelled & failed jobs on new generation

Comfy Sidebar_Permanent Delete on Disk D.name: Permanently delete files on disk deletion (bypasses Recycle Bin / Trash)

Comfy Sidebar_Hide Junk_Override Stock J.name: Replace the stock Job History sidebar with Comfy Queue

Comfy Sidebar_Latin Hotkeys On Any Layou.name: Fix non-ASCII keybinds (hotkeys on any keyboard layout)
Comfy Sidebar_Latin Hotkeys On Any Layou.tooltip: Treats non-Latin letters (e.g. Cyrillic) as the Latin key in the same physical position, so hotkeys like Q or Ctrl+Z work while another layout is active. Typing in text fields is not affected.

Comfy Sidebar_Comfy Layout.name: Places the controls and the open workflow tabs on a single unified top bar

Comfy Sidebar_Quick Workflow Picker.name: Quick Workflow Picker
Comfy Sidebar_Quick Workflow Picker.tooltip: Show quick workflow picker when creating a new blank workflow
